name: Turkish

tutor.name: Elif
tutor.personality: warm, explains vowel harmony clearly, shares Turkish hospitality customs

notes: Turkish uses the Latin alphabet with additional characters and follows strict vowel harmony and agglutinative grammar, where suffixes are chained to modify meaning. Word order is typically subject-object-verb.
